_meta.description: Declares the fields shillinq already writes and OpenRegister dropped because no schema declared them: the recurring invoice provenance the double billing guard filters on, the quick draft's customer reference, the GL account per invoice line and the requester of a payment request raised through the leaf API. ARInvoice's version is also moved in school-contributions.json, the last fragment that sets it, because a later fragment's scalar wins the merge.

recurringProfileId.description: The recurring invoice profile this invoice was generated from. Empty on an invoice made by hand.
recurringProfileId.title: Recurring profile

billingPeriod.description: The month a generated invoice bills, as year and month. With the profile it keeps a period from being billed twice.
billingPeriod.title: Billing period

customerReference.description: The customer's own reference for this invoice, such as their order number.
customerReference.title: Customer reference

invoiceLines.title: Invoice Lines
invoiceLines.description: A list of invoice lines entries.

glAccount.description: The revenue account this line is booked on.
glAccount.title: GL account

requestedBy.description: The user who asked for this payment from another app's record.
requestedBy.title: Requested by
